grammar.title: Giving examples with 比如
grammar.explanation: 比如 (bǐrú) means "for example, such as" use it to introduce one or more examples supporting what you just said.

grammar.title: About to happen: 就要...了
grammar.explanation: 就要...了 (jiùyào...le) shows an action or event is about to happen very soon, like "be about to". A time word can go in front: 明天就要...了.

sentences.en: Mom is about to come back.

sentences.zh: 我喜欢很多东西，比如茶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan hěn duō dōngxi, bǐrú chá.
sentences.en: I like many things, for example tea.

sentences.zh: 我们讨论了很多问题，比如工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen tǎolùn le hěn duō wèntí, bǐrú gōngzuò.
sentences.en: We discussed many issues, for example work.

sentences.zh: 她认识很多人，比如老师、学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènshi hěn duō rén, bǐrú lǎoshī, xuéshēng.
sentences.en: She knows many people, for example teachers and students.

sentences.zh: 这儿的天气不太好，比如经常下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèr de tiānqì bú tài hǎo, bǐrú jīngcháng xiàyǔ.
sentences.en: The weather here isn't great for example, it often rains.
